description: A human skeleton lies on dark soil among rocks and moss, partially covered by clusters of bioluminescent white mushrooms that emit a soft glow. Several small black beetles crawl on the bones and mushroom caps, with two rustic ceramic pots positioned near the skeleton.
title: Skeleton in Glowing Mushrooms
prompt: A realistic photograph of a complete human skeleton lying supine on dark earthy ground surrounded by grey rocks and patches of green moss. Numerous glowing white mushrooms with translucent caps and stems grow around and through the ribcage, skull, arms and legs, emitting soft bioluminescent light. Small black beetles crawl on the bones and mushroom caps. Two ancient-looking ceramic pots sit nearby. Dramatic low-key lighting with cool tones, moody and atmospheric, high detail, cinematic composition, dark background with rocks
